summary: P01 V2.47.231 fixes three Owner-reported Navigation Production defects from V2.47.230: category sorting now uses the complete active sibling set from admin bootstrap instead of the visible/non-empty subset; Pending quick view is placed immediately below All Websites; Pending rows can be organized either back to Navigation with a required formal category or to canonical peer subsites channels/watch/topics/books/projects via existing resource_domain_profiles mutation, clearing Pending on the same canonical URL asset. Tools/Software remain derived views. RPD/SSOT/Functional Contract/Acceptance UX-49 are aligned. No Schema/Migration, no second Category/Pending/URL authority, no auth/session/security semantic change, no updater mechanism change, no provider/server write and no Production write. Production remains Owner-manual.
